$comment: One fixed subject for each image domain, so that the previews compare styles and not scenes. No real persons, no brands. 'suffix' is added to each prompt of the domain. 'drop' removes primer words that make the model draw text or frames that do not belong on the page. A style override changes the subject or the frame only where the domain subject cannot show the style. A style override can also give 'drop' for primer words of that style only.

photography.subject: a corner of a small-town street with a parked car, plain house fronts with windows and doors, a bare brick wall, and one person who walks past
photography.suffix: no readable text, no signs, no logos, no watermark

film.subject: a still frame from a film: two people talk across a kitchen table at night, with a window behind them
film.suffix: a clean frame with no on-screen text, no captions, no titles, no interface, no logos, no timestamp, no timecode, no digits
film.frame: a still frame from a film,

painting.subject: a small harbour with fishing boats, a stone quay, a row of houses and one figure on the quay
painting.suffix: the painted surface fills the whole image edge to edge, no picture frame, no wall, no gallery, no easel, no signature text

interior.subject: a living room seen from one corner at eye height, 24 mm lens with the camera at 120 cm, level verticals, two walls in view, a sofa, a low table, a rug, a window on one side and one pendant lamp, nothing cut at the frame edge, no door frame in the foreground, no people

industrial.subject: a product still life on a plain plinth against a seamless backdrop: one table lamp, one tap, one wall switch, one vase, one cup and saucer and a small sample of the upholstery fabric, soft studio light from the left, a three-quarter view at eye height, each object whole and in sharp focus, no room, no people
industrial.suffix: no readable text, no logos, no labels, no packaging

logo.subject: a logo symbol for a fictional coffee roaster: one coffee bean with one curl of steam that rises from its centre crease, on a plain ground, centred, the symbol alone with wide empty margins
logo.suffix: symbol only, no letters, no text, no slogan, no real brand

architecture.subject: a public building on a city square, seen from across the square at eye height, two-point view with level verticals, the whole building in the frame with sky above, a few small people for scale
architecture.suffix: architectural photograph, no readable text on the facade, no logos

icon.subject: a 3 by 3 sheet of nine different app icons, each glyph used once: top row house, envelope, camera; middle row calendar, gear, bell; bottom row magnifying glass, heart, folder; on a plain ground
icon.suffix: no letters, no text, no labels, no logos

design.subject: a wide still-life picture of coffee: coffee beans, one cup of coffee and a coffee roasting drum on the right side, open empty ground on the left
design.suffix: one flat picture that fills the whole frame, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no user interface, no buttons, no browser window, no device frame, no page layout

architecture-elevation.subject: a straight frontal elevation photograph of a freestanding public building on a wide empty city square: the camera stands on the central axis and faces the main facade square on, one-point view, the facade is parallel to the image plane, all verticals and horizontals level, the whole building in the frame with open plain sky above it and at both sides, no neighbouring buildings, nothing at the left and right edges of the image but sky and paving, no trees, no people
architecture-elevation.suffix: architectural elevation photograph, plain overcast sky, no readable text on the facade, no logos

game.subject: a video game screenshot of a small village square at dusk: a two-storey house front with an open door into a lit room with a table and a lamp, a cobbled street, one tree and one small player character in the square
game.suffix: a clean game frame with no readable text, no logos, no HUD, no menus, no score, no watermark

logo/art-nouveau-monogram.subject: an Art Nouveau vignette for a fictional coffee roaster: one coffee bean with one curl of steam in the centre, framed by two symmetric whiplash coffee branches with leaves and berries, on a plain toned paper ground, centred, wide empty margins

logo/minimal-wordmark.subject: a minimal symbol for a fictional coffee roaster: one oval coffee bean seen from above, outline drawn in one monoline stroke, with the centre crease as one S-curve line that continues up as one curl of steam, on a plain white ground, centred, wide empty margins

painting/abstract-expressionism.subject: an abstract expressionist painting of a harbour at dusk, where the boats, the quay and the houses dissolve into gestural fields of colour and drips

painting/minimalism-painting.subject: a minimalist painting of a small harbour reduced to a few flat fields of colour: sea, quay, a row of houses, two boats, the flat colour fields run to all four edges of the image, no white margin, no wall, no canvas edge

painting/rococo-painting.subject: a rococo painting of a small harbour with fishing boats, a stone quay, a row of houses and one figure in pastel dress on the quay, the scene fills the whole image, no ornamental border, no cartouche, no flower garland frame, no ribbons at the edges

painting/ukiyo-e.subject: a Japanese ukiyo-e style image of a small Edo-period harbour with wooden fishing boats, a stone quay, a row of wooden houses with tiled roofs and one figure in a kimono on the quay, flat colour areas with bold outlines, the scene fills the whole frame edge to edge, no modern buildings, no power lines, no paper, no margin, no border, no seal, no inscription

logo/flat-logo.subject: a flat logo symbol for a fictional coffee roaster: one coffee bean with one curl of steam that rises from the crease, drawn from three flat solid shapes in two colours, on a plain white ground, centred, wide empty margins

logo/glossy-3d-logo.subject: a glossy 3D logo symbol for a fictional coffee roaster: one coffee bean made of warm brown and amber glass with one curl of steam above it, top gloss highlight, floor reflection, on a plain white ground, centred, wide empty margins

logo/victorian-trademark.subject: a Victorian trademark device for a fictional coffee roaster: an engraved coffee branch with beans and leaves and one steaming coffee pot inside one oval frame with engraved scroll ornament, on a plain cream ground, centred, wide empty margins, the frame and the scrolls are blank with no letters and no words, nothing in the corners

logo/geometric-symbol.subject: an abstract geometric symbol for a fictional coffee roaster: a coffee bean reduced to one solid circle split by one S-curve of negative space, on a plain white ground, centred, wide empty margins

painting/fauvism.subject: a fauvist painting of a small harbour with fishing boats, a stone quay, a row of houses and one figure on the quay, the colour patches cover the whole canvas to all four edges, no white margin, no vignette

painting/symbolism-painting.subject: a symbolist painting of a small harbour at dusk with fishing boats, a stone quay, a row of houses and one veiled figure on the quay, the scene fills the whole image, no ornament, no scroll corners, no border

painting/realism-painting.subject: a realist painting of a small harbour with fishing boats with plain unpainted hulls, a stone quay, a row of houses and one fisherman at work on the quay, no names or numbers on the boats

painting/photorealism.subject: a photorealist painting of a small harbour with fishing boats with plain hulls, a stone quay, a row of houses and one figure on the quay, no names or numbers on the boats, no shop signs

logo/emblem-badge.subject: a round embroidered badge for a fictional coffee roaster: one coffee bean with one curl of steam in the centre of a closed roundel, the outer ring is plain and blank, on a plain white ground, centred, wide empty margins

logo/swiss-modernist-mark.subject: a Swiss modernist symbol for a fictional coffee roaster: a coffee bean built from two solid half ellipses with one straight gap between them, on a plain white ground, centred, wide empty margins
